subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Does the security/automation owner accept updating the credentialed composite-action revisions, including `openai/codex-action` from `e0fdf012…` to `52fe01ec…`, after exact-head workflow validation completes?
rationale: This is a supply-chain trust decision for action code that runs in workflows receiving OpenAI, GitHub App-token, Docker, and release credentials; source inspection can establish compatibility but cannot substitute for repository ownership of the approved revision set.

options.title: Accept the reviewed revisions
options.body: Approve the pinned upgrades after the current-head workflow suite completes successfully and the owner accepts the upstream action changes.

options.title: Split credentialed action updates
options.body: Land only the lower-risk action refreshes now and send Codex, token, Docker, and release-path revisions through a narrower security-reviewed PR.

recommendation.title: Accept the reviewed revisions
recommendation.body: Approve the pinned upgrades after the current-head workflow suite completes successfully and the owner accepts the upstream action changes.

likelyOwner.reason: The current docs-agent history shows direct ownership of the most security-sensitive Codex workflow call path.
